responses.text: Damn straight I would! Let's see what you got.

topics.prompt: Want to play a hand of Caravan?

responses.text: That was too easy. How about we play again and this time you actually try.
Dammit. I should have won that match. Let's play again.
I'll be here if you ever want a rematch.

topics.prompt: I'm all done playing for now.

responses.text: I hope you're ready for this.
So I heard you helped take over Nelson from the Legion. Glad to see someone making a difference around here instead of just complaining.
Thanks again for finding those supplies. I've already started putting them to good use.
If it isn't the guy that saved President Kimball. We owe you a big debt of gratitude. If Kimball died, I don't know what would have happened.
If it isn't the gal that saved President Kimball. We owe you a big debt of gratitude. If Kimball died, I don't know what would have happened.
I can't believe that President Kimball is dead. If I could get my hands on the people that did this I'd rip their heads off with my bare hands.
I can't believe someone tried to assassinate President Kimball. I'm just glad he's still alive. We need a guy like him around.
Are you new? No one told me about any new troops showing up. {irritated} This is just great, we get new troops and no new supplies for them.
I didn't expect someone as famous as you here. What can I do for you?
Nice to see a friendly face around here. We don't get many visitors of your esteem. Something I can do for you?
You better watch yourself around here. I'm not going to put up with any crazy shit.
Didn't expect someone like you around here. What do you want?
You've got a lot of nerve showing your face around here. You better get out before I throw you out.
{gruff} What do you want?
If you're looking for supplies I'll make this easy for you... there aren't any.
But something tells me you're not here for that. What do you want?
I still don't have any supplies to spare. Is there something else I can help you with?
So the Major has you running errands for him. Well, we're short on personnel as well as supplies so we'll take all the help we can get.

topics.prompt: Major Polatli sent me to help you out.

responses.text: Not good. If we don't get more supplies, we're going to have to start using dirt for food and sticks and rocks for weapons.
Hey, how'd you like to do something for me?
Better now that all those Legion troops in Nelson are dead. The NCR might actually have a chance of kicking their asses after all.
Things are still pretty damn rough, but we're keeping it together.
Thanks. Watch your back out there. Never know when those Legion bastards might show up.

topics.prompt: [PRESS DEMO] I'll look for your men and supplies. Send me to HELIOS One.

responses.text: Maybe, but the situation around here calls for it. You gonna help or not?
I take it my men were dead. It's a high price to pay, but these supplies will save a few lives here.
Thanks for finding these. You should check in with the Major, he'll want to know about this.

topics.prompt: I found the supplies you were looking for.

responses.text: Damn it all... I sent some men out to get these supplies, but they never returned. I guess the Legion got them on their way back.
At least we have the supplies. It's not much, but every little bit counts.
Thanks for finding these. You should check in with the Major, he'll want to know about this.

topics.prompt: Speaking of supplies... I found some nearby, are they yours?

responses.text: Me? I've been doing this shit for far too long and have been in too many battles to remember.
Still... this has got to be one of the worst situations I've been in. Not too much I can do about it but do my job and do it right.
Have you changed your mind? Are you willing to help me out with something real simple?
I want you to collect NCR dogtags from our fallen troopers. That way I can keep track of who's gone and how to reallocate our supplies.

topics.prompt: I'm always willing to give a helping hand.

responses.text: Suit yourself. Let me know if you change your mind.
Hey, you've been a big help. I wanted to give you something for helping me out. It's not much, but here you go.
Good work. If you find any more, you know where to find me.
It's easy. Just bring back any NCR dogtags you find and I'll try to make it worth your while.
What do you want to know?

topics.prompt: I wanted to ask about your missing men.

responses.text: Bad? I've been doing this a long time and I haven't been in many places that were worse than this.
We've been out here on the front lines for a long time without any reinforcements or resupplies. That's what I need your help for.
I sent some troops out to find more supplies, but they never returned. I need you to track them down and help them bring back the supplies.

topics.prompt: The situation looks pretty bad here.

responses.text: Is that a joke? Have you looked around? Massive casualties, constant raids, barely any food or equipment... does that sound alright to you?
Shit, we haven't had a proper resupply since god knows when. Last time I sent troops out to find supplies, they never returned.
The Major sent you because we don't have any men to spare. So why don't you make yourself useful and find those troops and supplies for me.

topics.prompt: Quit complaining, it's not that bad here.

responses.text: The Major let me send out some troops to gather supplies, but unfortunately they never returned. I'm guessing they ran into some trouble on the way.
You can help by finding the troops and assisting them in bringing back any supplies they found.

topics.prompt: How can I help with your supply problems?

responses.text: I sent them to HELIOS One to see if they had any supplies they could spare. They've got to be somewhere between here and there.
I'd try searching the main road, or checking with the men at HELIOS One to see if they know anything.

topics.prompt: Any idea on where I should start looking?

responses.text: It's dangerous, but not as bad now that we've taken back Nelson from the Legion.
Of course it's dangerous! Damn Legion raiding parties have been giving us hell ever since they took over Nelson.
Hell, my men probably got ambushed by a raiding party! But we need those supplies, and we need them badly.
Make it quick, I don't have time to stand around talking all day long.

topics.prompt: I'd like to ask about something else.

responses.text: We really need those supplies, so don't take your sweet time finding them.
No, can't say I do. I've got my own problems to worry about.

topics.prompt: Do you know anything about Dr. Richards' missing medical supplies?

responses.text: I don't have any supplies to spare, but I've got caps if you have anything you don't need.
I don't have any supplies to spare for someone with your spotted reputation, but buy your stuff for half the going rate.
You're welcome. Enjoy.
I'm not going to argue with you there. Thanks, I appreciate this.

topics.prompt: Whatever it is, I think you need it more than I do.

responses.text: Uh huh.
